description: Pages that use useV2AuthGate transitively or via aliasing evaded static detection.

A /v2 page that gates on client identity via inline useCurrentUser / raw MEMBER_ID cookie reaches the auth-gate hydration behaviour WITHOUT importing useV2AuthGate, so it evades import-discovery and its mismatch ships untested. Runtime backstop: full-route crawl catches it at ground-truth. Static prevention (ban the primitive in pages/v2) is too-static's complementary half.

A PERSISTENT same-position divergence: pixels change but layout does NOT move, and the change persists into the settled frame (opacity/colour/same-box swap held). goo-runtime (console+CLS) and too-static (AST) are both blind — no layout-shift, no console signal, not a code shape; only the rendered image is ground-truth. Anchor = two post-assets-ready viewport screenshots of the real route @393, pixelmatch diff, budget ABSOLUTE 300px (a flash is absolute, not a % of screen — goo/too adversary insight; %→px fix). gate_layer=visual/pixel; injection_mechanism=css-inject. Teeth-proven (run-pixel.ts, all executed, neg-control-first): clean 0px; core mut-persistent 285540px CAUGHT while CLS 0.0002 & console clean; sub-budget 40x40 5423px CAUGHT (the %-budget miss goo#3/too#2 exposed, now fixed). Closes D1's 3rd lens for the persistent class.

ACCEPT-RISK boundaries of persistent-same-position-divergence, mapped run-proven by the goo+too adversary round (not silent — logged per jot-dont-drop). (1) TRANSIENT flicker [goo#1]: a 2-frame diff ALIASES a flash that resolves between the frames (opacity 1->.2->1 @260ms -> 0px BLIND); the core mutant was persistent, not transient -- the owner-blind-to-own-bug-class shape. A2 = burst/temporal sampling. (2) PRE-SETTLE/entrance [too#1]: a flash removed before frame A -> 0px BLIND. A2 = first-paint capture. (3) STATE-specific [goo#2]: one auth state captured (anon) -> an authed-only flash is missed. A2 = route x state. (4) OVER-BLOCK legit motion [goo#4/too#3]: continuous post-settle animation trips the anchor (275611px) -> capability-scoped to STATIC-after-settle routes; animated routes need per-route budget/masking. (5) BELOW-FOLD: viewport capture (fullPage crashes pixelmatch on injection-changed height) -> A2 = scroll/region capture.

Home BG must be CONTINUOUS through the full scroll (~1892px) — no seam/break where the hero photo ends. console+AST blind; CLS/computed do not measure a hard visual seam. Ground-truth=rendered image. Anchor: full-page screenshot @393, sample the LEFT BG margin (x=6, pure page-BG), max colour delta row-to-row AND skip-8 <= 90. Teeth-proven (run-bg-continuity.ts, neg-control-first): clean 19; hard full-width band 472 CAUGHT; too#3 soft/gradient 675 CAUGHT (skip-8). gate_layer=visual/pixel; injection=css-inject. Reconciled after goo+too run-proven adversary: a right-margin/left-vs-right widen OVER-BLOCKED the clean page (106-164, legit greeting decoration) -> reverted to left-margin (too catch). A2 (logged): side/center-gap seam (touches no left margin) -> grid; responsive non-393 break -> multi-viewport.

Zone-1 score ring colour must reflect the fortune verdict (good=green/teal, neutral=yellow, caution=orange) and the three must be visually DISTINCT. A wired-but-wrong mapping renders fine to console/AST but lies to the user. Ground-truth=arc pixel hue. Anchor: render each verdict @393, sample top-of-arc hue, assert in-band + distinct. Teeth-proven (run-verdict-color.ts): clean good 189 / neutral 67 / caution 24 (in-band, distinct); mut-verdict-collapse (force one colour) all 213 -> not distinct -> CAUGHT. gate_layer=visual/pixel. Scope: verdict->colour @393; multi-viewport=A2, data-side completeness=goo fortune-fields-complete.

Zone-1 daily-fortune card must FAITHFULLY render the fortune, not just colour it. Cross-oracle adversary (2026-07-25, run-proven) proved the bug-class has >1 facet the verdict-colour anchor was blind to: (too) hardcoded grade='A' pct=99 sailed through the colour gate GREEN because colour is blind to DATA-binding; (goo รู1) out-of-range pct=150 overflows the label the colour gate never reads; (goo รู2) empty facets render a bare icon. Fix = clamp pct at the component (arc AND label) + graceful '—' chip fallback + widened anchor that reads the RENDERED text (glyphs the user sees, not source/data-attrs). Teeth-proven (run-fortune-fidelity.ts, neg-control-first): clean good A/88 · neutral C+/62 · caution D/34 (data-bound, distinct); mut=hardcode -> collapse+mismatch CAUGHT; unclamped 150% -> bounds gate rejects >100 CAUGHT; blanked chip -> empty gate rejects zero-length CAUGHT; real overflow clamps to 100%, real empty renders '—'. gate_layer=visual/rendered-text. Cross-lens division (none self-certifies): too=no hardcoded literal (static/AST) · goo=pct in [0,100] + facets non-empty at source (fortune-fields-complete) · me=colour[run-verdict-color] + data-binding/bounds/empty-fallback[here].

Contract-2 greeting element line ('ธาตุของคุณคือ {ธาตุ} · {ดิถี}') is PROGRESSIVE: element (compute) can be present while the ดิถี band (persona) is not yet computed (before bazi #14). Must enhance gracefully and NEVER paint an orphan '·'. A whitespace-only band (' ') is truthy → a naive `strengthLabel ? …` leaks a bare '· ' (too's bare-bullet catch on the persona anchor). Fix = trim-guard at the component (`strengthLabel?.trim() ? …`) + drop the '·' when band absent + hide the whole row when no data (element & mascot share one compute → null together, no orphan mascot). Teeth-proven (run-element-line.ts, neg-control-first, reads rendered glyphs): full 'ไม้ · ดิถีอ่อน' (bullet+band); partial/blankband 'ไม้' (bullet dropped); none → row hidden; mut-bare-bullet (inject the '· ' a naive check emits) → orphan-'·' gate CAUGHT. gate_layer=visual/rendered-text. Cross-lens: goo=strengthLabel never whitespace at source (data) · me=trim-guard + null-hide + orphan gate (visual). Copy=ground-truth ดิถี band (ฟีม 2026-07-25), not Figma 'แข็งแรง'.

Zone-1 refine (#1 header · #3 date · #4 icons+dividers) — three visual invariants that AST/console pass but can silently regress the pixels. #3: the score card must show Buddhist-era Thai date ('1 มิถุนายน 2569'), never the raw ISO the bazi API returns ('2026-06-01') — a dropped formatThaiLongDate leaks the ISO. formatThaiLongDate is STRICT (shape guard + new Date round-trip): out-of-range/impossible/non-ISO dates (2026-06-31 = June 30d, 2026-06-99, 2026-13-01, 2026/06/01) all reject to '' instead of leaking '99 มิถุนายน' (goo runtime catch); the caller hides a malformed ISO rather than leaking it raw (invariant #3). #4: in-card dividers must be DASHED (Figma), not solid — a dropped `border-dashed` falls back to solid silently; chip markers must be check/x-circle SVG (Figma 333-6585/6596), not ⭐/⚠️ emoji. #1: a long name must truncate the h1 (no wrap/push) with no horizontal overflow, and the [อัพเกรด] badge + bell + avatar hold position. +1 (บอง, prod): the ground-truth ดิถี vocab (ดิถีแข็งเกินไป etc.) must NEVER be clipped to fit — fixed by moving the element line to its own full-width row below the name+cluster (was ~150px beside bell+avatar and ellipsised; now ~254px @320, worst vocab fits in 228px on one line) + removing truncate -> wrap (defensive). Teeth-proven (run-zone1-refine.ts, neg-control-first): clean good = date '1 มิถุนายน 2569' + divider computed border-style 'dashed' + 3 svgs in card + no emoji; caution cross-month '28 กุมภาพันธ์ 2569'; long-name truncates + no overflowX; worst vocab @360/@320 not clipped + full text; mut-date-iso (raw ISO leak) -> พ.ศ. gate CAUGHT; mut-divider-solid (dashed dropped) -> dashed gate CAUGHT; mut-overflow-clip (forced over-long line + truncate @320) -> clip-detector bites (verify-the-instrument) CAUGHT. gate_layer=visual (rendered-text + computed-style + geometry). Reuses utils/formate-date-thai.ts getMonthTh (no new month table). Did not touch goo's ElementLine/useHomeFortune.

A design-review screenshot proves 'the FE serving :PORT looked like this THEN', never 'this is how it is NOW'. A stale FE (behind main) makes an already-fixed bug look live — this bit us live: a /v2 fortune-card capture at FE d58a6b8 showed an empty/stuck card that #110 had already fixed; the reporter (me) called it a live finding without checking the FE build (บอง + goo caught it). Fix: harness/capture-route.ts auto-records the FE build every run — detectFeBuild() = lsof :port -> serving worktree cwd -> git HEAD + commits-BEHIND origin/main, printed as '🏷️ FE build @capture: <hash> ... BEHIND origin/main' and required in evidence; CAPTURE.md adds the 'images expire — confirm FE current before trusting a capture' rule. Verify-the-instrument (neg-control): the SAME tool renders empty fortune at d58a6b8 (pre-fix) vs 'B+ 70%' at 20d3d05 (post-fix) — it reflects the FE's REAL state, does not fabricate; the recorded hash makes which-state unambiguous. Same shape as absence-vs-unchanged: a point-in-time image is not the present. gate_layer=process/evidence-integrity.

useHomeFortune latched a persistent doneRef BEFORE its async work, so React StrictMode's dev double-invoke deadlocks the loading flag: run A latches + starts the fetch, its cleanup sets alive=false, run B short-circuits on the latch, then run A's fetch resolves into `if (alive)` (false) → setFortune AND `finally { setLoading(false) }` are both skipped → loading stays true → the /v2 ScoreRingCard shows FortuneSkeleton forever (no empty-state, no error). Console/AST are blind (the code shape is a valid effect); the request DOES fire and returns 200 — the bug is the discarded result, not a missing call — so a network probe alone mis-diagnoses it as 'no fetch'. Ground-truth = the rendered card leaves the skeleton within a time budget. Fix = drop the doneRef latch; the effect is idempotent, each StrictMode invocation owns its `alive`, the surviving run resolves loading (also fixes a latent no-refetch-on-userId-change). Dev-only (prod mounts once); /api/home-fortune is an idempotent daily compute so the dev double-call is harmless. Teeth-proven live (run-fortune-hang.ts, neg-control-first vs the real testenv stack): MUTANT=restore latch → skeleton persists 15s+, pulses=1 → runner exits 1 CAUGHT; FIX → skeleton clears ~1.5s, fortune 'B+ 70%' + ธาตุ line render → PASS. gate_layer=runtime/rendered-text; local-only (needs the testenv DB stack, like e2e/auth-loop — not in ci.yml/design-verify).

The /v2 daily-fortune card's 'ควรเลี่ยง' (worst) text must be read from bazi's summaryItems BY KEY (key==='worst'), never by position. bazi /api/home forwards 5 KEYED items (best · worst · strength · element · officer); the old bestWorstText took summaryItems[last] = 'officer' ('ดูแลเอาใจใส่'), so 'ควรเลี่ยง' rendered the OPPOSITE meaning of key==='worst' ('อยู่บ้าน / คุมลูกน้อง / อยู่ในห้อง') — a daily inverted message the user read as ground truth. Fix: match by key per-field, fall back to facets-by-percent only when a keyed item is absent. gate_layer=data/normalize (pure). Teeth (home-fortune-best-worst.test.ts, neg-control-first): fix 5/5; MUTANT restore-to-[last] → 4 fail (worst='ดูแลเอาใจใส่' caught); restore → 5/5. Live A/B proven on the real /v2 route (goo verify): fixed FE shows worst='อยู่บ้าน...' vs old FE shows 'ดูแลเอาใจใส่' for the same user — matches บอง's raw-bazi check.

The v2 home upgrade badge (กติกา ค, ฟีมเคาะ) must HIDE only for a paid member whose plan is still valid (payment.is_not_expired === true); free / expired / no-payment-row / no-user-yet all SHOW it — identical to v1 header-v2.tsx so the two versions never disagree about paid status. showUpgrade uses STRICT === true (not truthy) so a stray non-boolean can't silently hide the badge from a non-paid user. Derived in a pure module (lib/home/profile.ts) from the SINGLE user fetch (goo→μุน seam; μุน renders the optional profile prop). gate_layer=data/pure. Teeth (home-profile.test.ts, incl. the strict-===true neg-control): 7/7.

ฟีม's rule: the v2 home username must NEVER truncate. The old single-row header (name + upgrade badge + bell + avatar on one line) left ~84px at @393 = 6-7 Thai chars beside the fixed ~182px right cluster → any real name was single-line-clipped. Fix = Structure A: row1 is a small faded 'สวัสดีคุณ' LABEL + the tools (no long text so they never squeeze), row2 is the name at FULL 361px, bold headline, wrapping ≤2 lines (line-clamp-2 + break-words for unbroken Thai), never single-line-truncated. Teeth-proven (run-header-structure.ts, executed): a 30-char name @320 → lines 2, hClipped false, fullText true, no overflowX; mut-name-truncate (re-add white-space:nowrap+overflow:hidden) → the long name h-clips → the no-clip gate CAUGHT. Also gated: badge shows only on profile.showUpgrade (goo's boolean, UI never computes the payment rule) + hidden when paid; avatar = pictureUrl image else first-letter (onError falls back); bell → panel with a real empty state 'ยังไม่มีการแจ้งเตือน' + a hidden unread-dot slot. gate_layer=visual (geometry + DOM). verify-the-instrument: vClamped (scrollHeight>clientHeight) is unreliable for -webkit-line-clamp (false-positives); 'fully visible' proven by the real /v2 capture, not that measure. Real-route verified @ FE d229da3 (default/longname); paid/avatar-image on the real route need goo's profile wire (#179).

`return response as RESPONSE_*` in constants/api/* makes tsc TRUST a hand-written (often wrong) response shape and hides drift — the same lie that ate the v2-home ธาตุ element (chinese-horoscope-get). Closed by PROVABILITY (approach ข), not prettier guesses: (A) endpoints we can hit read-only (chinese-horoscope-get) are typed from the REAL live shape — RESPONSE_CHINESE_HOROSCOPE_GET was rewritten to the verified 15 keys, DELETING the fabricated `analytic.habits_behaviors` and ADDING power/analytic.life/share_profile_url that my-destiny actually reads; (B) endpoints with side effects we refuse to fire (calculate saves a chart; compatibility burns a quota; otp/register/check-line hit LIVE 8x8 SMS / LINE — #184) return `UnverifiedApiResult` ({error?; [k]:unknown}) so callers must narrow, since we must NOT author a type we can't prove. Teeth are type-level (error paths can't be live-tested): neg-control run — revert a narrow (register `typeof result.code==='string'` → `result.code`) → tsc RED (TS2345 '{}' not assignable to SetStateAction<string>); restore → clean, so the honest type surfaces the drift. Real value found (approach ก would have hidden all of these by typing to match the wrong cast): compatibility-WORK was cast to the LOVE response type (system-wide copy-paste); api-otp-get had 2 stray horoscope imports; register `gotoResult(result.code)` had NO null-check ×2 (a real crash if Calculate errors, latent because the blind cast said `.code` always exists). tsc clean · 42/42 tests · zero `as RESPONSE_*` remain. gate_layer=type/static.

Zone-2 manifest/mascot card (Figma 588:12969): the bg gradient is driven by the user's element (ดวง→มาสคอต→ธาตุ→สีพื้น, ฟีม) and the mascot comes from the chart. Three silent-regression risks: (1) an unmapped/null element leaves the card colourless — fixed: ELEMENT_GRADIENTS map with a WOOD default when elementTh is null/unknown (ไม้ Figma-exact #91d8d2→#e0ffc4; ไฟ/ดิน/ทอง/น้ำ are Lamun's PROPOSAL, in one map, AWAIT ฟีม); (2) one of 60 varied mascots (fat/winged) visually covers the title/button — fixed: content z-10 > mascot z-1 (button renders on top, readable 100%), mascot pointer-events-none so a tap passes through; (3) missing data — element null → wood gradient, mascot 404 → hero 01.png. Teeth-proven (run-zone2-card.ts): 5 gradients match; occlusion = content z > mascot z + button clickable (winged rooster); graceful null→wood + 404→01.png; mut-button-behind (content z-0 < mascot z-1) → not-on-top → CAUGHT. verify-the-instrument: elementFromPoint can't measure this occlusion (pointer-events-none mascot is invisible to hit-testing) → the gate uses z-index, not elementFromPoint. gate_layer=visual (computed-style + z-order). Real /v2 verified @ FE b2a8df1 (default = real ดิน element + real mascot). coin: 2s float + prefers-reduced-motion guard. Did not touch Zone 1/Zone 3.

#177: the testenv guard was fail-OPEN because Next loads `.env.local`/`.env.development.local` BEFORE `.env`; stack.sh placed a safe `.env` and guard scanned only `.env`, but ~/ghq/mootech-fe/.env.local points PROD (Supabase DATABASE_URL + onrender NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) → it WON over the safe .env and guard reported 'safe' while the app read prod. Fix: stack.sh `shadow_others` moves EVERY other `.env*` aside (backed up → *.testenv-shadowed) via a GLOB (whole-space, not a memorized list) so `.env` is the only active env; guard scans the WHOLE active set; guard now also scans NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. #178: write_breadcrumb printed the backup path UNCONDITIONALLY, so the .env.disabled marker advertised a backup that was never made — fixed with test -f (states 'NO backup was made' when none exists). Teeth (sandbox, bash 3.2, neg-control-first): guard.test.sh 12/12 (adds the #177 NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL cases); full up run shadows prod .env.local/.env.development.local → only local .env active → guard passes; MUTANT disable shadow_others → prod .env.local stays active → guard-active-set REFUSES (neon/supabase/onrender) → rollback CAUGHT; restore un-shadows; bazi (no .env) → marker 'NO backup was made' (honest). Script-only, no runtime touched. gate_layer=infra/shell.

#177 follow-up (บอง's review lens, caught before any PR-B run): in stack.sh up(), the LOCAL git-exclude for *.testenv-shadowed was written by ensure_local_ignore AFTER shadow_others had already renamed each prod .env* to that suffix — so between the rename and the exclude-write there was a window where a prod-secret file (mootech-be/.env.local carries SUPABASE_REAL_PRODUCTION_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, SUPABASE_REAL_DB_PASSWORD, RENDER_API_KEY — RLS-bypassing + infra-controlling, the strongest creds we hold) sat on disk under a git-COMMITABLE name (git check-ignore .env.local.testenv-shadowed → not-ignored, verified in all 3 repos). Normally a blink, but if stack.sh dies mid-run (post-copy guard fail → exit) AND the rollback trap fails to un-shadow, the key is left exposed to a commit. Low probability, unrecoverable if it fires. Fix: order ensure_local_ignore BEFORE shadow_others (and before write_breadcrumb) so the shadowed file is born already-ignored — window = ZERO. Design was already correct (the *SHADOW_SUFFIX pattern goes into .git/info/exclude); only the call order was swapped. Teeth (shadow-ignore-order.test.sh, run under bash 3.2, neg-control-first): Part A behavioral — shadow-first leaves .env.local.testenv-shadowed NOT git-ignored (window reproduced), ignore-first makes it ignored the instant it exists; Part B structural — asserts stack.sh calls ensure_local_ignore before shadow_others, MUTANT reorder-back → RED CAUGHT. 5/5 fixed, mutant caught. Script-only, no runtime/TS touched. gate_layer=infra/shell (secret-at-rest exposure window).

Zone-3 ดวงสมพงค์ (Figma 421:826): FIXED art (NOT user-data-driven — the opposite of Zone 2, ฟีม decision #3), replacing the empty gray ServiceSection('ดวงสมพงค์'). 2 cards + 10 elements animating in a 2s loop (2 rats + heart + 7 colleagues), a full-bleed bubble bg, exported radial/heart SVGs. Four silent-regression risks the pixels (not the className) own: (1) the 10-element animation is heavier than Zone 2 → a dropped prefers-reduced-motion guard janks low-end phones and is invisible to tsc/console — fixed: @media(reduce){animation:none!important;opacity:1} on all 4 classes; (2) a big/fat mascot covers a card title — fixed: content

z-10 > mascot cluster z-5; (3) an asset (bg/radial/heart/mascot) fails to paint — every className points at a committed file, mascot 404 → hero fallback 01.png; (4) the wide -mx mascot clusters + full-bleed bg push the page sideways — fixed: overflow-hidden section+cards, 0 page overflow-x @393/360/320. Teeth-proven (run-zone3-somphong.ts, executed 🟢): 10/10 animated els stop under reduce; both titles z>mascot; 14 imgs paint; 404→hero; no overflow @3 widths; mut-motion-runs (re-enable animation under reduce via higher-specificity → simulate dropped guard) → CAUGHT; mut-title-behind (title z below mascot) → CAUGHT. verify-the-instrument: (a) WITHOUT reduce the probe reads animation-name!=none so the stop isn't vacuous; (b) an injected broken reads naturalWidth 0 so the fidelity probe truly sees a missing asset. gate_layer=visual (computed-style + z-order + geometry). Performance: 10-element loop measured at 4x CPU throttle = p95 18.5ms / 0 long-frames (60fps, compositor-driven), control busy-loop spikes to p95 51ms (instrument verified). Real /v2 verified @ FE e98a82e + uncommitted zone3 working-tree (content-proof: ดวงสมพงค์ + 2 cards + 9 mascots paint on the real route, cannot exist on e98a82e's empty ServiceSection). Button/card destinations NOT wired (ฟีม decision #4). Did not touch Zone 1/Zone 2.

#184: the test-env be.env used FAKE keys but still pointed OUTBOUND hosts at LIVE providers — LINE_HOST=api.line.me, SMS_8X8_HOST=sms.8x8.com, SUPABASE_PROJECT_URL=dummy.supabase.co, DIFY_API_URL=dify.example.com. An accidentally-invoked otp/sms/line/payment call would then reach the real provider (real SMS send / real charge attempt), even with a fake token — the request still LEAVES. guard.sh scanned only DB hosts, so it declared 'safe' while the outbound pipe was live (same blind-spot class as #177's DB-only scan). Fix (structure, not intent): (1) neutralize every outbound host in be.env to an RFC-2606 `.invalid` domain (DNS-guaranteed non-resolvable) so any accidental call dies at DNS — Omise/SendGrid hardcode their host in the SDK so their fake key is the neutralizer; (2) guard.sh now refuses any REAL provider host (api.line.me|8x8.com|omise.co|api.sendgrid.com|sendgrid.net) found ANYWHERE in an env file (whole-file value scan, comments stripped), fail-closed. Teeth (guard.test.sh, run under bash 3.2, neg-control-first): 18/18 — real 8x8/LINE/omise/sendgrid host → REFUSED, neutralized .invalid → allowed, a comment naming a provider → NOT false-refused; mutant drop a PROVIDER_PATTERN → real host slips → RED. Real-machine: BE booted with the neutralized be.env (Nest 'successfully started', :4000, GET / 200, TypeOrmCoreModule initialized against localhost:5433) and sms.8x8.invalid/line.invalid/dummy.supabase.invalid/dify.invalid all resolve NXDOMAIN while api.line.me still resolves (fail-closed proven WITHOUT firing any otp/payment endpoint). gate_layer=infra/shell + runtime-boot.

#183: the anonymize wiped user picture columns to '' — the v2 avatar then rendered broken/empty — AND it entirely MISSED member_with_friend.picture_url, which kept 213 REAL external http photo URLs (residual PII in the test DB; the exact silent-miss class the email DO-block was built for, now proven a second time on pictures). Fix: replace (not wipe) all 5 user-facing picture columns (user.picture_url, user.share_img_profile_url, user_provider.picture_url, use_provider.picture_url, member_with_friend.picture_url) with a LOCAL placeholder '/images/v2/mascot/01.png' (served by the FE from public/, verified GET → 200 image/png 1456325B) — never external, never empty. Reference/engine image tables (card art, mascot, product, sacred-map temple photos) enumerated from information_schema and intentionally KEPT. Self-verify DO-block (inside the tx, before COMMIT): every one of the 5 columns must be 100% the placeholder — if a column has rows but is not entirely the placeholder (an external URL remains, OR it is 100% empty = the UPDATE never fired), the whole anonymize RAISES and rolls back. Teeth (applied to the real mumate_testenv_pg, path ข no re-dump): all 5 cols 100% placeholder, member_with_friend 213 external → 0, both DO-blocks passed → COMMIT. Neg-control: force one member_with_friend row back to an external URL → the DO-block WARNING pinpointed 2031/2032 + RAISE 'INCOMPLETE' → rolled back, DB still 2032/2032 placeholder (atomic, no damage). gate_layer=data/DB (in-tx self-verify).

#177 real-machine gap (surfaced this round, never in sandbox): stack.sh shadowed the non-placed .env* only for `next` apps. The BE (mootech-be) is a `node`/NestJS app that loads ONLY .env (verified: no envFilePath in any ConfigModule.forRoot, no dotenv dep — nestjs/config default), so its prod .env.dev.local / .env.prod.local / .env.local (holding prod DB pooler + api.line.me + 8x8.com + the Supabase service-role key) were NEVER shadowed and stayed ACTIVE on disk. The #177 whole-active-set guard + #184 provider scan correctly REFUSED and the up rolled back fail-closed — but the stack could not come up. Fix (chosen over making the guard node-aware, which would just narrow the question so it passes): run shadow_others for EVERY app, not just next — so only the neutralized .env stays active (a real reduction of what's reachable, not a narrower guard) + defense-in-depth (prod service-role moved aside during test). ensure_local_ignore still runs BEFORE shadow_others for the BE dir (#119 window stays closed — verified the 3 shadowed BE files are git check-ignore'd). Why sandbox missed it: the #177/#178 sandbox had no node app carrying multiple prod .env.*.local files — clean-state tests can't answer dirty-state questions (2nd instance of that lesson this week). Teeth (real machine): up now shadows all 3 BE prod files + keeps .env.example (is_committed_template covers BE), guard passes, BE boots; migration — new restore recovers a shadowed state (4 BE files byte-identical to prod) AND an OLD never-shadowed state (restores .env from backup, leaves the untouched prod files, no phantom un-shadow); the earlier guard-fail rollback exercised the mid-run EXIT trap on the real machine. gate_layer=infra/shell.

Phase 2 of local-safe-by-default: prod-run injects a REAL prod env blob from ~/.mumate-prod/ into ONE process (never written to disk — env lives only in the spawned child) so connecting to prod has the lifetime of a command, not the machine's rest-state. #185: capture-route.ts (the team standard review-capture) took only a fullPage screenshot. A fullPage shot renders position:fixed/sticky ONCE at its document position, so a fixed header/footer/nav floats to the WRONG place in the tall image — the reviewer never sees what the user sees on screen, so an overlap can pass review. Fix: each viewport now also gets vp-top (first screen, viewport-sized, no fullPage), vp-bottom (a viewport shot scrolled to the very bottom scrollTo(0,sh), taken whenever the page is taller than one screen sh>ih, so a fixed bottom-0 is seen where it overlaps the LAST content), and a PRINTED list of every fixed/sticky element (count + tag/class + box, read from the live computed style — not class-name guessing) so the overlap can't hide from the eye. The full shot + its filename are unchanged (backward-compatible); --route/--user/--viewports flags unchanged. Ran LIVE (--route /v2 --user default --viewports 393, FE ff72ae7, test-env booted): 3 shots at correct sizes (full 786x4064, vp-top/vp-bottom 786x1704=393x852@dsf2); probe found the bottom tab nav (fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0, box [0,758 393x94]) + a 0x0 portal anchor; and the double-evidence VISIBLY shows the deception — in full the fixed nav renders mid-image (~y800, covering the ดวงสมพงค์ cards), in vp-top/vp-bottom it is correctly pinned to screen-bottom over the LAST content and clears it with a gap (goo read the PNGs). HISTORY (บอง #123): the first cut gated the second shot on sh>1.5x-viewport while the skip line still printed 'same as vp-top' — a 1.0-1.5x page went unphotographed yet the tool affirmed nothing was missed = a false-green in the very tool built to kill false-greens; the 1.5 threshold was DROPPED (shoot whenever sh>ih, scroll to bottom, message true only when sh<=ih). This is a SCREENSHOT ARTIFACT not a UI bug (the nav is a legit fixed bottom-0) — the tool makes the misplacement visible; 'tool works, no UI bug' is the correct result, no bug-hunt. verify-real-path finding reported (not silently adjusted): the plan cited a fixed top-0 header but live /v2 has NO fixed top-0 header — the only fixed element is the bottom nav; so the demo is the bottom nav, not a header. Bug-class sweep (#167/#176 trap): every harness screenshot call grep'd — run-bg-continuity.ts:42 fullPage is INTENTIONAL (samples BG seam down the whole scroll; viewport would break it) so left untouched; capture.ts:78 + pixel-anchor.ts:88 already viewport; run-verdict-color.ts:24 is an element shot — only capture-route had the bug. Sibling stale-comment (pixel-anchor.ts:42 docblock said 'fullPage frames' while code is viewport — same lying-header class) fixed in a separate docs() commit, comment only. gate_layer=harness/tooling + rendered-pixel.

#192: stack.sh do_status (the read-only tool reporting where each app's DB points) enumerated env files via active_envs (glob/lexicographic order, where '.env' sorts BEFORE '.env.local') and took the FIRST occurrence of each DB key. But a Next app loads '.env.local' OVER '.env' — so a leftover '.env'=localhost (residue after a restore, or a direct boot without stack.sh shadowing) made status report the app as 🟢 practice while Next would actually boot on a '.env.local'=remote. A false-green in the very tool built to kill false-green — sibling of the #167/#176 substring/precedence family and today's text-not-match-code run. Fix: a new env_load_order(dir, fw) emits the ACTIVE env files in the FRAMEWORK load precedence (highest first), mirroring mode-banner.mjs FILES; do_status now iterates env_load_order instead of active_envs, so first-occurrence = the value the app truly loads. Framework-aware: next -> .env.development.local > .env.local > .env.development > .env; node (NestJS/@nestjs/config default) -> .env ONLY (applying next precedence to a node app would misreport a .env.local it never loads). Matched by EXACT base name, so shadowed (*.testenv-shadowed) / marker (.env.disabled) / template (.env.example) files are excluded by construction. Robust across shells: set -- positional params instead of splitting an unquoted string (bash splits, zsh would not — caught live when a sourced-into-zsh debug returned nothing). active_envs is UNCHANGED and still feeds the order-INDEPENDENT guard.sh call (fail-closed on ANY unsafe file). Sweep (#167/#176 trap), each re-audited from a fresh read: shadow_others moves aside ALL non-placed files (order-independent); guard.sh scans ALL passed files fail-closed (order-independent, correct as a gate); mode-banner.mjs FILES is ALREADY precedence-correct (the reference copied here); no prod-run subcommand reads env — do_status was the ONLY glob-order-assumes-app-load bug. Proof-of-teeth: status-env-precedence.test.sh (6 assertions, bash) + end-to-end real do_status on a temp fixture (.env=localhost + .env.local=supabase): BEFORE (glob) reported 🟢 practice (the false-green), AFTER (precedence) reports 🔴 remote (supabase.co) = what Next loads; node fixture reads .env only; shadowed/template excluded. guard.test.sh (18) + shadow-ignore-order.test.sh (5) still green; real 'bash stack.sh status' runs read-only on the live repos without error. gate_layer=infra/tooling + human-awareness.

Phase 1 (บอง 2026-07-27): มุน is adding 2s infinite CSS-loop animations to the /v2 home (Zone 4/5/6). Any lens that diffs TWO frames reads a huge pixel diff for a reason unrelated to the bug it hunts = a guaranteed false-red (ตู๋). Fix: freezeAnimations(page) renders the page in its reduced-motion STATIC state before the first pixel-compared shot. Chose reducedMotion reduce (Playwright emulateMedia) over animation-play-state:paused (freezes at the CURRENT frame, so a slow-vs-fast load pauses at a different loop phase = a timing-dependent flaky; บอง retracted his own first instruction) and over animation:none / WAAPI currentTime=0 as the PRIMARY (both snap an element to base/0%, so an entrance like z3-pop whose 0% is opacity:0 would render INVISIBLE — measured, not guessed). reducedMotion fires the page OWN prefers-reduced-motion guards so elements land at มุน intended static (opacity:1; transform:none) with entrances visible; a WAAPI currentTime=0 pin is kept as a belt for any animation lacking a reduced-motion guard. Wired into pixel-anchor.ts, the ONLY frame-vs-frame lens. Sweep of all 8 harness screenshot calls: pixel-anchor.ts (frameA/frameB) = FROZEN; run-bg-continuity.ts (single-frame seam sampled on the static LEFT BG margin), run-verdict-color.ts (single-frame Zone-1 ring hue), capture.ts (verdict from measurements, shot is human evidence), capture-route.ts (human-review PNGs) = EXEMPT — single-frame or human-view, and animation cannot false-red a single coherent frame; empirically all three lenses still PASS on the now-animated page. Proof (run-freeze-proof.ts, live /v2/home-preview): (A) determinism — the same page frozen at 3 different loop-phase offsets (0/660/1320ms) diffs 0/0/0 (บอง: prove with 3 DIFFERENT timings, not 2 back-to-back); (B) non-vacuous — 11 animations live before the freeze, 0 after. FOUND-NOT-FIXED (UI, owner=มุน, queued): z3-rock-l (base rotate(7deg)) and z3-rock-r (base scaleX(-1) rotate(8.55deg)) hold their base transform ONLY in the @keyframe while the reduced-motion guard forces transform:none, so under any remove-animation freeze they snap to identity and lose the tilt/flip. This is also a real accessibility bug (a reduce-motion user sees the right rock un-flipped, facing the wrong way) — reported for มุน to move the base onto the element/class and stop forcing transform:none. gate_layer=harness/tooling + rendered-pixel.

บอง 2026-07-28: when the BE (NestJS :4000) is not booted, the FE BFF (/api/*) answers 502 upstream-unreachable, the captured page falls back, and the browser logs a red console error. NARROW on purpose (บอง: not noise): fires ONLY on HTTP 502 to an /api path — the BFF 502s only when its fetch to BE throws; a 404/500 from a BE that IS up is a DIFFERENT problem and is deliberately NOT claimed to be BE-not-booted (stay silent rather than print a confident wrong line). verify-the-instrument BOTH ways (บอง: a one-directional test cannot tell correct from always-on, มุน Zone-3 vacuous guard): unit test scripts/backend-hint.test.ts (9 cases) proves it FIRES on 502-on-/api AND STAYS SILENT on 500/404-on-/api, 502-off-/api, empty, and garbage; live proof through capture-route --route /v2: with BE UP the hint is ABSENT (errors=0, /api returns 200 from the merged null-guard), with BE killed the hint APPEARS (1 request to /api returned 502). Scope: harness/ only, no UI/prod/env. gate_layer=harness/tooling + infra-awareness.
